en: Vintage divided‑back postcard with embossed floral Art Nouveau border. The front shows a black‑and‑white photograph of a grand, multi‑storey historic building framed by decorative blue flowers and green stems. At the bottom of the image and in the margin there is Hungarian text indicating greetings from the city of Pécs. The reverse bears standard multilingual postcard headings of the Universal Postal Union era.
